data_fields.name: stack_max_amount
data_fields.donor_constant: u32::MAX for stackable kinds; 1 otherwise (no game cap)

best_idea: Check that every item fits before a container pickup or a bag removal, and keep the items past a shrunk slot count in a remove-only overflow list, so no item is ever lost or half-moved.
decision_why: The precheck-then-commit rule, the remove-only overflow list and the server calling the same inventory code fit Frankendom's one-engine, server-verified and one-ledger rulings; unbounded stacks and the partial-fill order are not taken.
acceptance: On a 375-wide phone, walk over a chest holding a three-piece container with two free slots: the pickup is refused whole, the chest keeps the container, and a 'Bag full' line shows once; a server test asserts the ledger is unchanged. Unequipping a bag with no free slot is refused and the bag stays equipped.
